terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: Solved from the reference silhouette: the top-face diamond implies elevation ~24 degrees, and the near-orthographic look with generous margins implies a long lens (fov 8 at distance 20). Screen-space cube/base ratio measures 0.69 against the reference 0.68; the model is not baked to this view.

objectClass.notes: A single-view neon display object: a 3x3 glass lattice cube resting on a two-tier drilled platform with a smaller glowing cube suspended at its centre.

reasoning: Four primary solids plus a transform root form a shallow but exact hierarchy that must not be collapsed into one mesh.
The identity comes from repetition: 54 panes, 24 seam bars, 12 outer edge rods, 12 inner edge rods, and three emissive perimeter rims.
Transparency creates layered occlusion; the inner cube must remain readable through the outer lattice, so material order and depthWrite flags are part of the structure.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The object is geometrically simple but identity-defining detail is dense and repetitive, so the spec needs macro parts, meso lattice groups, micro emissive features, and local material overrides.

detailInventory.note: Every identity-defining detail maps to a component.localFeatures entry, a component id, or a material.localOverrides entry.

details.description: 45-degree chamfer about 0.02 wide along the outer top edge; catches a bright violet highlight.
Rounded lip r=0.04 around the 1.64 square opening; the wall is vertical and dark.
The opening is a real through-hole, not a decal; the inner platform is visible inside it with a 0.08 gap.
The inner platform top sits 0.02 below the outer platform top, producing a visible step ring.
The inner slab sits on the floor plane inside the opening, so the recess reads dry and the two platforms never intersect.
Nine panes per face, 0.424 square with 0.012 gaps; the pattern repeats on every face.
Four seam bars per face (two horizontal, two vertical) at +/-0.218 from the face centre.
Twelve 0.014 rods trace the cube silhouette and read brighter than the panes.
Twelve 0.010 rods on the 0.88 core cube; visibly hotter than the outer edges when seen through the glass.
Closed rounded-square tube r=0.012 lying on the outer top edge.
Closed rounded-square tube r=0.010 around the opening edge.
Closed rounded-square tube r=0.010 around the inner platform top.
Low-roughness clearcoat highlight sweeping across the front-facing panes.
Semi-translucent dark-violet platform with a broad top-face highlight and darker hole wall.
A point light plus 0.30 sprite gives the core its hot centre and halo through the glass.
Per-instance brightness varies about 6 percent so the lattice does not read as a flat repeated shader.
The brightest bloom point sits on the near base corner where the outer rim meets the bevel.
The core cube is 0.88 across, 0.667 of the outer cube, centred on the same axes.

anatomy.note: Not a character; anatomy does not apply.

qualityContract.qualityBar: Reference-fidelity neon glass cube: exact four-part hierarchy (outer cube, inner core cube, drilled outer platform, inner platform), 3x3 pane lattice on all six faces, two-tier platform with a true through-opening, emissive violet-only palette, and a static bloom composition whose brightest point is the front base corner.
definitionOfDone: The render shows four separable parts in the correct parent-child order with the cube resting on the inner platform.
All six faces carry a 3x3 pane lattice, 24 seam bars and 12 emissive edge rods; the inner core cube reads through the glass.
Palette stays inside hue 250-315 degrees plus white; no cyan or green pixels are visible.
The preview is static, renders at 60 fps at 1280x900 with at most 12 draw calls, and the spec validator plus semantic checker pass.

featureGroups.name: Overall silhouette and proportions
qualityCriteria: Cube side / base side is 0.66 +/- 0.03 and the cube is a true cube, not vertically stretched.
Platform thickness / base side is 0.08 +/- 0.01 and total model height is 1.46 relative units.
The two-tier platform step of 0.02 and the 0.08 ring gap are visible at review distance.
failureModes: cube reads as a generic box on a flat slab
platform thickness or cube ratio is guessed without measurement
inner platform is welded to the outer platform with no step

featureGroups.name: Four-part hierarchy and contact points
qualityCriteria: base-outer -> base-inner -> cube-outer -> cube-inner parent chain is explicit in the component tree.
Each primary part has its own pivot group, socket and collider proxy.
The cube bottom rests at the inner platform top (y=0.14) with a 0.001 seat tolerance, not floating and not sunk.
failureModes: all geometry merged into one mesh
cube floats above or sinks through the platform

featureGroups.name: Drilled two-tier platform
qualityCriteria: The outer platform has a real 1.64 square through-opening with rounded corners r=0.04.
The 1.48 inner platform sits inside it with a 0.08 gap on all four sides.
Three emissive perimeter tubes trace the outer edge, the opening edge and the inner platform edge.
failureModes: opening is a dark decal rather than geometry
inner platform fills the opening completely with no visible gap
rim tubes are missing or float off the surface

featureGroups.name: 3x3 pane lattice and seam system
qualityCriteria: 54 panes (6 faces x 9) with 0.424 size and 0.012 gaps.
24 seam bars at +/-0.218 from each face centre plus 12 outer edge rods.
The 12 inner edge rods on the core cube read hotter than the outer edges.
failureModes: fewer than 9 panes on a visible face
seams disappear at the face edges
inner cube is subdivided instead of solid

featureGroups.name: Neon glass material response
qualityCriteria: Panes use additive low-opacity violet glass with clearcoat and no transmission.
Platform glass is semi-opaque, depth-writing, with darker hole walls.
Neon material is HDR white-violet above the bloom threshold and uses additive blending.
All materials declare textureless with evidence because the reference is a synthetic neon render.
failureModes: panes read as flat opaque purple
inner cube disappears behind the glass
neon rods bloom into a white screen

featureGroups.name: Reference lighting and bloom composition
qualityCriteria: Key, fill, rim and core lights plus exposure 1.05, ACES tone mapping and background #04010a are specified.

UnrealBloom strength 0.05, radius 0.25, threshold 1.00 keeps the background dark while matching the reference halo width; the HDR composer target plus OutputPass makes even a small strength bloom strongly, so the nominal pass values are the tuned ones.
The front base corner is the brightest region and the frame corners stay above 90 percent dark.
failureModes: ambient-only lighting with no key/rim structure
bloom is uniform instead of concentrated at the near base corner

visualDeltaChecks: bloom concentration and palette hue delta

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: The reference is a synthetic neon render with no sampled surface detail; every material documents textureless with evidence instead of fabricating PBR maps.

mustAvoid: single flat albedo per material without local overrides
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare palette and local color zones.
Compare glass opacity, clearcoat highlight and neon emission under light.
Compare rim and seam emission at the base.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as glass-panel-array, outer-edge-frame, inner-core.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: Only one reference view exists; the back, bottom and inner cavity are assumed symmetric.
The 3x3 pane lattice continues on all six faces.
The platform opening is a true through-hole with rounded corners r=0.04.
The floor grid belongs to the preview harness, not to the model.
Bloom is a post effect; emissive geometry supplies the HDR values but not the glow itself.

materials.name: Transparent violet glass pane

albedo.samplingNotes: Panes read saturated violet because the emissive term dominates; lights are dim so additive stacking cannot desaturate them toward white.

colorVariation.pattern: per-instance brightness jitter across the 3x3 lattice

roughness.localResponse: uniform dielectric roughness; emissive-dominant panes carry the violet read so dim lights cannot desaturate them

ambientOcclusion.notes: Geometry-driven darkening at pane gaps; no AO texture.

evidence: The reference is a synthetic neon render: panes show a flat violet tint with no grain, print, pores, or wear patches at 1437x1094.
Pane-to-pane brightness differences are captured by instanceColor jitter and local overrides, not by a sampled texture.

shaderNotes: Additive low-opacity panes create depth without screen-space transmission.
Emissive #6e1eff at 0.9 carries the pane colour; the violet hue matches the reference's saturated panes instead of drifting toward pink.
DoubleSide is required because the pane array is seen from both sides.
materials.notes: Hero pane material for the 54-pane lattice.

materials.name: Semi-opaque violet platform glass

albedo.samplingNotes: Platform faces read saturated violet from the emissive term; the hole wall stays darker through geometry AO rather than a light gradient.

roughness.localResponse: uniform dielectric roughness; the platform read comes from emissive violet rather than a light-driven top-face gradient

ambientOcclusion.notes: Darken the hole wall, step ring, and cube contact line.

evidence: Platform surfaces are flat dark violet glass with no sampled grain or print at reference resolution.
The visible value change from top face to hole wall is a geometry/lighting gradient, captured by local overrides.

shaderNotes: depthWrite true so the platform occludes the floor grid correctly.

buildPasses.goal: Refine bevels, pane lattice, seam bars, edge rods and rim paths.
acceptance: 54 panes, 24 seam bars and 12 outer edge rods are present and aligned.
Rim tubes follow the rounded-square paths without cracks at the corners.
Inner cube is 0.88 (2/3 of the outer cube) and centred on the outer cube.
Eight 0.03 corner markers sit on the outer base and cube top faces.

buildPasses.goal: Match glass opacity, emissive palette, clearcoat and local material overrides.
acceptance: Panes are additive at opacity 0.15; the outer base is semi-opaque at 0.88.
The inner base uses the darker glass-base-inner material instead of the outer base glass.
Neon rods use additive HDR white-violet above the bloom threshold.
Four 2.00 x 0.44 x 0.004 light sheets fade upward from y=0.16 with additive blending.
Core cube stays readable through the glass.
All materials declare textureless with evidence or are utility sprites.

buildPasses.goal: Add geometry-driven AO, contact darkening and pane-instance variation.
acceptance: Hole wall and step ring darken through local overrides, not a texture.
Pane jitter breaks the flat repeated shader.
No albedo map is reused as roughness or AO.

buildPasses.goal: Match the key/fill/rim structure, exposure, background and bloom.
acceptance: Key, fill, rim, core and under-base lights are present with the specified colours and distances.
ACES exposure 1.05, background #04010a and bloom 0.05/0.25/1.00 are set.
The front base corner is the brightest region and the frame corners stay dark.

buildPasses.goal: Expose stable pivots, sockets and collider proxies for future actions.
acceptance: Each primary part has a named pivot group and socket.
Colliders are simplified boxes with trigger flags where appropriate.
Exploded-view translations do not break the parent-child transforms.

buildPasses.goal: Keep the model inside the triangle and draw-call budget.
acceptance: Triangles <= 25000 and draw calls <= 12.
Panels are instanced; rods and rims are merged.
No shadow map, transmission or per-frame allocation.

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Reach accepted visual fidelity first, then optimize without removing the 3x3 lattice, the two-tier platform or the inner core.

lightingFromPhoto: key light: broad violet-white key from front-left-high at (-2.6, 3.4, 2.8) (#b07bff, intensity 1.5, distance 12) producing the left-face highlight sweep seen in the reference.
fill light: dim magenta fill from rear-right (#ff4fd8, intensity 0.15, distance 10) keeping the back edges readable without flattening the core.

rim/environment light: violet ambient (#341470, intensity 0.35) plus an under-base point at (0, 0.12, 0.85) (#b23cff, intensity 1.8, distance 3) that brightens the near base corner as in the reference.
core light: #ff5ce0 point at the core centre (0, 0.80, 0), intensity 1.5, distance 2.2, feeding the inner cube and the halo sprite.
exposure 1.05 with ACESFilmic tone mapping; background #04010a and FogExp2 #060212 density 0.012 (kept low because the long-lens camera sits 20 units away).
contact shadow/ambient occlusion: no shadow map; a dark contact gradient at the platform seam plus geometry AO at the hole wall anchors the base.
proceduralStrategy: Block out the four primary solids and the two-tier platform first.
Cut the 1.64 opening as a real hole in the extruded frame.
Build the pane lattice as one InstancedMesh and the seam/edge rods as merged meshes.
Build the three rim tubes from rounded-square paths and merge them.
Place the inner cube at the outer cube centre with 12 merged edge rods.
Add the core light and the halo sprite.
Apply textureless neon glass materials with local overrides for the hole wall and front corner.
Add key/fill/rim lighting, ACES exposure and bloom; verify the front base corner is the brightest point.
animationAnchors: root pivot supports whole-assembly translation, rotation, scale and visibility
base-inner pivot supports lifting the inner platform out of the opening
cube-outer pivot at bottom-centre supports exploded views along Y
cube-inner pivot at centre supports core rotation and visibility toggling
destructionAnchors: panel-grid instances can detach as individual glass shards
cube-edges, seam-grid and inner-edges are separate merged meshes and can be hidden as groups
base-inner lifts out of the hole-seat socket
